name: Low-Block 4-4-2

slots.why: Distributes quickly to the forwards after a save or claim.
Support full-back stays back and helps his wide midfielder defend.
Central defender in a deep block. Cover is the alternate.
Central defender on the right. Cover is the alternate, but only one Cover can be used.
Wide midfielder tracks back to help the full-back and keeps the bank of four narrow.
Defensive central midfielder protects the space in front of the defence.
Ball-winning midfielder wins the ball back in front of the box.
Wide midfielder on the right, doing the same job as on the left.
Deep-lying forward (or Complete Forward) holds the ball up so the team can move up the pitch.
Advanced Forward runs in behind on the counter. Poacher is the alternate.

description: Two compact banks of four with two forwards retained as direct counter outlets.
whyGood: It keeps defensive jobs simple while preserving an immediate route out after regains.
whyThisShape: Two compact banks of four that defend deep and narrow, with two forwards kept as outlets. It gives the opponent no space in the middle and breaks out quickly with a runner and a hold-up forward.
whenToUse: Protecting a lead, or away against a stronger side. It suits disciplined players and wide midfielders who work hard to recover.
whenNotToUse: When you need to control the ball or score, since the team will be under pressure for long periods.

instructionRationale.Much Lower Line of Engagement: The team waits deep and defends near its own box instead of pressing.
instructionRationale.Much Deeper Defensive Line: Keeps the defence deep to remove space in behind.
instructionRationale.Narrower: Compresses the middle so the opponent is pushed wide.
instructionRationale.Counter: The two forwards are an outlet: the team attacks quickly when it wins the ball.
instructionRationale.Regroup: Drops back into shape after losing the ball.

keyRequirements: Centre-backs with reliable positioning and concentration
Wide midfielders willing and able to recover into the defensive bank
Central midfielders disciplined enough to protect the space in front of the box
One forward who can hold the ball up
One forward who can attack space on the counter
